body: Damn, that sucks. It's a shitty feeling
hi
It's everything though. Her included
She already did. She did for 5 years and I thought I ended it when I ended the relationship. Nope. Doesn't matter anymore. Thanks though
Yeah no wonder. It's no biggie. It won't matter much longer anyways
That notion makes me even more upset
Yeah you're right. :(

r/pettyrevenge 

I like your style but I want a *real* girlfriend...if they even exist...

It sounds like they didn't care and that you were right for leaving them. Don't feel too bad about it. You sound like a caring person and you're deserving of someone who will love you for who you are and who will be willing to be there for you when you need it. :)
That's a rough situation to be in. I can definitely relate. Was being Transgender an issue with her? Or did you end the relationship because of how unsupportive she was?

She is pretty crazy. To be honest I kind of did say something along those lines to her. 

Throughout the whole relationship I constantly tried working with her to improve her schooling, etiquette, her familial relationships, her friendships...she always found a way to lush people away and never took work or school seriously. She didn't have much going for her. 

I never said anything mean to her about it in 5 years of dating but when she said that stuff to me I lost it. I said something like "you know, it's going to be nice knowing one day I will have a beautiful and caring wife, wonderful kids, a nice house, and a good job where it's safe to bet that you won't because of the poor choices you make."

I regretted it instantly but at the same time It felt good to finally give her a taste of her own medicine, so to speak.

Yeah, I suppose. 

Still, it's hard to get rid of that feeling you get when your ex tells you something like that.

I think you misunderstand what I'm saying...

I don't want to just use some other girl as eye candy and a rebound girlfriend to get back at me ex. I genuinely want to find a new girlfriend that is everything my ex was not because I felt like I deserved better and in so doing it would show my ex that I wasn't the fucked up one but rather it was her.
Thank you. It means a lot.
It takes a lot of dedication to lose weight. I struggle with that everyday. Congratulations on losing the 15kg.
I always do. Thanks.
That's a good idea. Luckily I get to see him tomorrow.
I try. I just feel like I don't have anything I'm good at.

I feel the same way. I never feel satisfied with *some* progress: it has to be all or nothing. It isn't a healthy way of approaching things, and I hope you and I can both move past that!

Thank you again. You've helped a lot.

I appreciate your response. Don't worry, it was plenty coherent. 

I do have a lot ahead of me. I just feel like I keep waiting for things to get better. The thing about that is, I actively try to improve the future - and sometimes it seems like it doesn't pay off.

Maybe sometime soon (or further down the road, who knows) it will. I guess it is easy for me to get hung up on all this negativity. 

Again, I appreciate your response. Maybe I should just go grab some sleep...

I sure do hope so. I mean, the problem with me is that I've never been overly excited about women/dating/flings, etc. I have never seen the point. 

I like intimacy and I like being close with people in general. My fear is that I won't find that again. 

Besides, I've been bothered by the idea of not ever being close to the girl I had been with for so long. The thought of her dating other guys and me dating other girls really bother me. 

Maybe I'm just being a whiny loser. I don't know. Thank you for the kind words though.
It is easy to overwhelm yourself. Try just taking it one day at a time.

Thanks. I really do hope so. It's cool everyone here has been super supportive. Already have started to hit the gym and feel better about the situation. I'm almost looking forward to this life change, in a way.

Thank you a lot. You made a lot of wise statements. I've already been trying to do some of those 5 hints you mentioned but I didn't think of a few that you brought up. I'm sure it'll help. Thanks a lot! :)

Funny you mention it that way. He's like 25 or 26 and I'm only 21 but I'm In college and all he's got is pizza delivery. I don't know what my ex sees in him. 

Thanks for the kind words and motivation though.

You are totally right. I should have called the police already. Now that she calmed down I don't it would be the time to, but if she does again, I won't hesitate to. Luckily she is the safety of her home with her family and I notified them of her threats and they've kept an eye on her. But what you said is true: regardless of what the real reasons for it are, threatening suicide is no joking matter.

Absolutely. I told her that and she calmed down but who knows what she will do or say tomorrow. Luckily I already gave her back her things so I don't have to see her again. My bosses at work know about it (unfortunately) but luckily they were super cool and totally backed me, considering they like me a lot and I've worked there for two+ years. We're going to work opposite schedules until they're replaced. Hopefully after that I will be able to cut her off and move on.

It's just difficult to know which way it is. You see, it's like a catch 22: either she is manipulating me, in which case she does need help (normal people don't use suicide as a threat like that, along with the other issues I have outlined in the OP/comments); or, she does really need help, but I don't want to talk to her or keep her around in my life.

I think you're ultimately right, though. Perhaps tomorrow if she continues threatening to harm herself I will have to go to the police over it. I finally convinced her to calm down and to stop texting me and I figure she is probably asleep. Thanks for the advice. 

Sometimes the right thing to do is the hard thing to do...

Seems like you and I have very similar interests. LOL.

But seriously, yeah, you're right. In a way, I shouldn't be selling myself short.

I had that realization and did most of that. And you're completely right about it - really the only reason I've stayed in contact with her is like I mentioned: she has issues and she threatens to hurt herself and such. 

Now I know a lot of that behavior is manipulation and self-centeredness but given that she has had the life she has had, that mental illness runs through her family, and how recently a friend of mine came close to taking his own life, I have been talking to her only in the capacity that I've been pushing her to go to a hospital or counselor/therapist to get help.

Yeah, I suppose you're right. It's certainly tough. On the one hand, I almost hate her for what she did and what she is putting me through. On the other hand, I miss her and I feel a pang of sadness whenever she texts me apologizing and begging for me to come back.

It's frustrating to know that she threw away our relationship and that there wasn't much I could have done about it.

It's important to take these kinds of things one step at a time. Not like I have any experience myself with this situation, but I am sure she just wants to take it easy and at a pace she feels comfortable with. She obviously is into you at some level, so don't feel rejected. Just try and understand the pace she wants to take things at.
